name: approve
description: Answers Claude Code's permission prompts through comando's approval cards. Claude Code calls it; do not call it yourself.

name: ui_show_table
description: Shows rows you hold as a table in comando. Use for results the user should scan, sort or copy.

title.description: Tab title; a later call with the same title replaces the table unless the user pinned it.

rows.description: One array per row, as many values as columns.

name: ui_plot
description: Plots numeric series over shared axes in comando: series [{name, x, y}], each x and y an array of numbers; one series may be given as x and y beside the title instead. With time_x, x values are epoch milliseconds.

x.description: one series' x values, instead of series

y.description: one series' y values, instead of series

name: ui_show_view
description: Shows a view in comando. type markdown: data {markdown}. diff: data {path, before, after}. text: data {path, text, syntax, line}. tree: data {root: {label, detail, children: [...]}}. table and plot take the same data as ui_show_table and ui_plot.

name: ui_set_editor
description: Replaces the whole text of an editor panel; the user's own text in it is gone (they can undo). Prefer ui_insert unless the user asked for a replacement. Without panel, uses the user's focused panel when it is bound to this session, else this session's first panel; a session bound to no panel must pass panel. A panel bound to another session is refused unless force is true.

force.description: Write into a panel bound to another session; only when the user asked for it.

name: ui_insert
description: Adds text to an editor panel as a block of its own; the user's caret, selection and text are never touched, and one undo by the user takes it back. append (the default) adds it at the end, after a blank line. insert places it right after the block the user ran last from that panel (the prompt that asked), or at the end when nothing ran: use it to answer next to the question. Without panel, uses the user's focused panel when it is bound to this session, else this session's first panel; a panel bound to another session is refused unless force is true.

force.description: Write into a panel bound to another session; only when the user asked for it.

name: ui_open_file
description: Opens a file in comando's side pane: a Markdown file at no line rendered, any other text file read-only and scrolled to the line, a binary file said to be one. ~/ is the home folder; relative paths resolve against the session's working directory. At most 4 MB.

name: ui_notify
description: Shows a message in comando's status bar and as a desktop notification.

name: ui_get_state
description: Returns comando's panels with their bindings and last SQL run, the connections, the sessions and the open views.

name: ui_set_layout
description: Arranges comando's window. Every argument is optional: panel focuses an editor panel by id or title; lower_tab selects results, session, approvals, terminal, or a view in the lower panel by id or title; sidebar and side_pane show (true) or hide (false) those panes; lower_share sets the lower panel's share of the window height, 0.05 to 0.95. The window is the user's: panel must be one bound to this session; lower_tab is selected only while the user looks at a panel of this session; a panel to focus (with its lower_tab) and pane changes wait until the user pauses typing, and the user can undo pane changes. Use it when the user asks, not to follow your own work.

name: ui_close_view
description: Closes a view this session placed, by the id ui_get_state reports. Views the user opened or pinned cannot be closed.

name: db_run_sql
description: Runs SQL on a database connection and returns rows as tab-separated text. Send one statement per call: text with several statements always needs the user's approval and returns only the first statement's result. Read-only statements run at once; others need the user's approval, and production connections refuse them. Without connection, uses the connection of this session's panel; a session bound to no panel must pass connection.

show.description: Also show the rows as a table view.

title.description: Title of the table view when show is true.

name: db_describe
description: Lists the columns of a table: name and type.

name: session_send
description: Sends a prompt to another comando session; nothing is asked of the user. The prompt, headed [from session <this session>], is added to that session's panel as a block of its own and run there, so the user sees what was sent and by whom; a busy session takes it after its current turn. Only when the user asked you to hand work to another session. The answer gives the cursor for session_read.

session.description: The session to prompt; another session, with an open panel.

name: session_read
description: Reads another comando session's transcript: its prompts, text, tool calls with results, notes and turn ends, as numbered blocks. after is the cursor (session_send returns one; each answer names the next); without it, the last 40 blocks. wait_seconds waits, up to 600, until that session has finished its turns. A block still being written or run is shown as such, and the next cursor shows it again.

after.description: Show blocks from this index on.
